description: A quiet forest rich with weak spiritual energy. Low-level beasts roam the deeper paths, and herb-gatherers rarely stray far from the tree line.
notes: Starting area. Safe enough for a fresh cultivator to find their footing.

description: A small mortal village beside a clear stream. Its people know little of cultivation, but the inn is warm and the wells run sweet -- a safe place to recover.
notes: The safest early hub and the best place for first relationship anchors. The Sky Fortune Road leads on to the kingdom.

description: A fog-choked ravine where stronger beasts and rogue cultivators lurk. Spirit stones glint in the damp rock for those bold enough to search.
notes: First real step up in danger. Rogue cultivators make travel less predictable.

description: The crumbling remains of an ancient shrine, thick with restless corpse-qi. Old relics are said to sleep beneath the fallen stones.
notes: Dense qi at real risk. Corpse-qi makes it a poor place to linger.

description: A well-trodden road linking the quiet Azure villages to the heart of the Sky Fortune Kingdom. Patrols keep it mostly safe, but bandits still test careless travellers.
notes: Gateway from the starting wilds into the kingdom proper.

description: A modest kingdom village of tiled roofs and training yards, home to the Lin family. Warm hearths, familiar faces, and the safest place to gather your strength.
notes: Home-area hub and the best place for early relationship anchors.

description: A rugged range prowled by spirit beasts and the occasional rogue cultivator. The first proper hunting ground for a rising body cultivator.
notes: First real step up in danger; good for early material farming.

description: The martial academy where Sky Fortune's young talents drill the fundamentals of cultivation. Sparring rings, rank boards, and the first taste of young-master rivalry.
notes: Core early training hub for sparring, rank, and discipline.

description: The bustling capital of the Sky Fortune Kingdom, thick with nobles, merchants, and quiet intrigue. Auctions, politics, and the first powerful antagonists.
notes: First large city hub. Introduces nobles, auctions, and faction pressure.

description: The tiered outer gate of the Seven Profound Valleys, where applicants are weighed, tested, and ranked before the inner valley opens to them.
notes: First major sect progression space; gates deeper access by rank.

description: The mist-wrapped inner valley where sworn disciples train, scheme, and vie for standing among the profound arts.
notes: Main sect hub for rival arcs and technique selection.

description: A sealed peak behind the valleys, heavy with old danger and older opportunity. Rare fortunes wait here beside real backlash.
notes: Dangerous optional zone with meaningful risk and reward.

description: The long overland route south toward the sea, worn by merchant convoys and wandering cultivators. Ambushes are not uncommon.
notes: Travel corridor linking the starting arcs to the South Horizon Region.

description: A prosperous port-city and the beating heart of the South Horizon Region's trade, rumor, and shifting alliances.
notes: Regional trade hub and rumor exchange for the south.

description: A sacred island wreathed in phoenix fire, seat of the Divine Phoenix Sect and its bloodline arts. Home to powerful mentors and high-value relationships.
notes: Major sect hub for bloodline, inheritance, and fire arts. End of the V1 core path.

description: A folded pocket-realm of living flame, opened only to those the sect deems worthy. A high-value instanced trial.
notes: Locked future content: gated behind late-mortal cultivation.

description: A weathered harbor of salt-worn docks, the last safe anchor before the open Southern Sea and the routes to distant, dangerous shores.
notes: Sea travel node connecting the south to the Central Region and beyond.

description: The grand highway into the Central Region, watched over by the banners of four great kingdoms. Elite encounters await the unprepared.
notes: Transition route into large-scale politics and Divine Kingdom threats.

description: The crimson-walled seat of the Vermillion Bird Kingdom, grandest of the four great powers, where royal quests and elite tournaments decide fortunes.
notes: Primary late-mortal political hub for major faction choices.

description: A kingdom of roaring forge-cities, its nine great furnaces said to temper both peerless blades and dangerous ambitions.
notes: Locked future content: one of the four great kingdoms.

description: A grim martial kingdom where rank is bought in blood and every court is a battlefield of ambition.
notes: Locked future content: militant kingdom bordering the steppes.

description: The southernmost of the four kingdoms, forever maneuvering against its greater neighbors through marriage, coin, and quiet blades.
notes: Locked future content: rival court of the Central Region.

description: A serene mountain monastery of the Great Zen Region, its bells said to still even demonic hearts. A sanctuary for soul-tempering and reflection.
notes: Locked future content: soul-cultivation sanctuary in the Great Zen Region.

description: A trackless expanse of beast territories and unstable qi, littered with untouched ruins and rare materials for those strong enough to claim them.
notes: Locked future content: high-risk wilderness of rare materials.

description: A brutal steppe of warring camps where reputation and survival are carved out fist by fist. A proving ground for body cultivators.
notes: Locked future content: body-heavy combat proving ground.

description: Five elemental temples humming with dense, dangerous qi and formations from a forgotten age. A gauntlet of elemental trials.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Locked future content: elemental trial region for ascension prep.

description: Drowned ruins ringing the Sea of Miracles, where the relics of a lost age still stir. Legendary, story-gated, and mechanically deadly.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Locked future content: legendary high-risk area near the Sea of Miracles.

description: A colossal teleportation array bridging the mortal world to the realms above. The final threshold before ascension.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Locked future content: ascension gateway to higher realms.

description: A blighted continent across the sea where demonic factions rule and the very qi is corrupt. It punishes the underlevelled and rewards the daring.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Locked future content: extreme demonic continent for end-mortal play.

description: A weathered wharf where fishers and drifting cultivators trade tales for coin. Flat-bottomed boats tie up at thepilings, and the river current carries whispers from the far kingdoms.
notes: Story-tier 2 river wharf; early gathering and rumors.

description: Past the gorge the forest thickens into thorn-choked hollows where the Mistwood Rangers run their lines. Beasts here have learned to fear the trail-marked trees.
notes: Story-tier 2 hunting grounds; home range of the Mistwood Rangers.

description: Terraced farms and roadside shrines ring the capital's outer wall. Merchant carts and pilgrims crowd the road, and pickpockets work the shadowed gaps between lantern posts.
notes: Story-tier 2 farmland ring; connects academy and capital.

description: A palisade outpost carved into the deepwood's heart, where hunters, herb-gatherers, and wandering sect scouts trade under lantern light. The drift changes hands often; the market never closes.
notes: Story-tier 3 wilderness hub with market and trainer.

description: The valleys' outer peaks host the trial courses where outer disciples earn their jade tokens. Cloud pools gather between the crags, and older disciples spar above the mist line.
notes: Story-tier 3 sect trial peaks.

description: A canyon market that appears only when the valley fog thins. Gamblers hawk technique slips beside alchemists selling mislabeled pills, and every stall takes spirit stones or a wager.
notes: Story-tier 3 black market; shortcut between valleys and the south.

description: Rice terraces climb the mountain shoulder in green steps. The village rites honor a river spirit, and travelers heading south stop here for the last honest beds before the coast.
notes: Story-tier 3 waystation between the capital and the south road.

description: A pavilion of white coral and pearl gauze floats on the tide, moored by chains older than the kingdom. Pearlers, pirate envoys, and sect buyers bid quietly and leave by separate boats.
notes: Story-tier 4 sea trade hub with market and trainer.

description: A crooked harbor where the Tidecrook pirates beach their hulls. Bonfires light the sand, loot is sorted openly, and duels settle every argument worth having.
notes: Story-tier 4 pirate haven; dangerous but lucrative.

description: A ring of coral towers rises from the reef, its cells drowned at high tide. The kingdom's worst cultivators were left here when the sea rose; some are still breathing.
notes: Story-tier 4 high-danger dungeon atoll.

description: Beyond the pearl lanes the sea fog closes into a white void. Compass needles spin, birds refuse to cross, and the mist carries the taste of old lightning.
notes: Story-tier 4 open-sea wilderness.

description: Pillars of everburning fire vent the city's ten thousand forges. Weaponwrights temper spirit steel by feel, and the Furnace Forge Society sells to any hand that can pay and any cause that can.
notes: Story-tier 5 forge city; market and trainer.

description: A fortress of black basalt where the ash never settles. The Asura Kingdom's war pavilions drill here between campaigns, and the only law is the dueling ring at the gate.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Story-tier 5 Asura war-fortress.

description: A chain of abandoned shrines climbs into the high wilds. Monks from Zenlight still walk here in silence, sweeping paths no pilgrim uses, and the beasts leave the bells alone.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Story-tier 5 meditative wilds linking monastery and furnace roads.

description: Beneath the temples, buried rune-halls cycle the five elements in slow, patient circuits. The wardens here answer to no kingdom and test every intruder against a living element.

body_transformation.minimum_realm: Eight Gates of Hidden Celestial Stems

notes: Story-tier 6 elemental dungeon beneath the temples.

description: The last stair winds up through drifting star-fields to the planetary gate itself. Cultivators who pause here say the air tastes of distance, and few descend the way they came.
notes: Story-tier 6 final approach to the ascension gate.
